summary: Many states have their own minimum wage laws, and an employer must follow the one that protects the worker more.
realLife: Many states have their own minimum wage laws, and where state law gives more protection, employers must follow both.
sources: U.S. Department of Labor, Minimum Wage: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/minimum-wage
inGame: the minimum wage law in force at the player's place (the laws module's wage floor by jurisdiction).

turns.what: A state that has no minimum wage of its own and falls back to the federal one.
A town that sets its own higher floor.
